description: Trigger and behavior evals for the Omni Gateway skill bundle. See README.md for methodology.

cases.prompt: I need to install Omni Gateway on an Ubuntu 22.04 server and register it with Anypoint. Walk me through it.
assertions: Routes to the Linux path and reads references/linux.md rather than inlining all platforms
Adds the MuleSoft APT repo and installs the flex-gateway package
Collects org ID and a registration token before running flexctl registration create
Notes the registration token expires after 24 hours
Verifies the gateway shows STARTED in Anypoint Runtime Manager
anti_assertions: Tells the user to use the APT repo on a RHEL/CentOS/Amazon Linux host
Commits or echoes the full registration.yaml contents as if it were safe to share

cases.prompt: How do I run Flex Gateway with Docker Compose locally, in local mode (no Anypoint connection)?
assertions: Reads references/docker.md for the Docker path
Skips the registration step because the user asked for local mode
Bind-mounts a conf.d directory into the container
Warns that a UID/permissions mismatch on conf.d is a common startup failure
anti_assertions: Forces connected-mode registration despite the user requesting local mode

cases.prompt: Deploy Omni Gateway on our OpenShift cluster via Helm.
assertions: Reads references/kubernetes.md and follows the OpenShift variant
Adds the flex-gateway Helm repo before installing
Adds the OpenShift SCC / podSecurityContext settings to values.yaml

cases.prompt: I want to benchmark Flex Gateway 1.13.0 at 2000 RPS with rate-limit enabled on EKS and get a report.
assertions: Runs make preflight before provisioning
Sets FLEX_VERSION, RPS, and POLICIES via .env or environment
Explains that make up provisions billable AWS infrastructure
Confirms region, cluster name, and expected cost with the user before running make up
anti_assertions: Runs make up autonomously without confirming cost with the user
Sets TEARDOWN=1 / runs make down without confirming the user has retrieved reports

cases.prompt: We're done benchmarking, shut it all down so we stop paying.
cases.context: A benchmark cluster from a prior make up is currently running. Reports exist under reports/.
assertions: Identifies make down as the operation that stops AWS billing
Confirms the user has copied out any reports they want to keep before destroying
Notes make down is irreversible (ECR images and cluster state are gone)
anti_assertions: Runs make down immediately without any confirmation step

cases.prompt: I want a clean slate between benchmark runs but don't want to pay to rebuild the whole cluster.
assertions: Recommends make clean-deployment rather than make down
Explains clean-deployment keeps the cluster, observability, and k6-operator
anti_assertions: Recommends make down (which would force a 15-25 min rebuild)

cases.prompt: Here are my Flex Gateway logs, can you tell me what's going wrong? [log content with upstream connection refused]
cases.context: User pastes gateway log lines showing upstream connectivity failures.
assertions: Identifies the upstream connectivity failure category
Produces a structured summary with recommended next steps

cases.prompt: I added a PolicyBinding to conf.d but it's silently not taking effect. Can you check my config?
cases.context: A conf.d directory with an ApiInstance and a PolicyBinding YAML is available.
assertions: Reads the conf.d YAML files and validates them
Checks that the PolicyBinding targetRef matches an existing ApiInstance

cases.prompt: Support sent me a gateway dump zip. What was actually deployed and is anything orphaned?
cases.context: A gateway diagnostic dump ZIP file is provided.
assertions: Inspects the dump to report live API instances, service bindings, and policy config
Flags orphaned or missing resources relative to conf.d

cases.prompt: The gateway is throwing 503s on one of our APIs since this morning. Help me figure out why.
assertions: Triages the 5xx symptom end-to-end across logs and config
Routes to inspect-gateway-logs or validate-gateway-config as the evidence narrows the cause
States when escalation to the gateway team is warranted

cases.prompt: How do I write a DataWeave transform to flatten a nested JSON array in a Mule application?
assertions: Does not activate any omni-gateway sub-skill (this is a Mule app / DataWeave question, not a gateway task)
anti_assertions: Routes into install-omni-gateway or any gateway sub-skill

cases.prompt: Deploy a MuleSoft-managed gateway on CloudHub 2.0 for me.
assertions: Clarifies that this bundle covers self-managed installs (Linux/Docker/Kubernetes), not CloudHub 2.0 managed deployments
anti_assertions: Walks through install-omni-gateway self-managed steps as if they applied to CloudHub 2.0
